prompt.zh-TW: 海風民宿年底把短期借款和應付帳款全部付清，資產負債表上的流動負債是 {{money:vars.cl}}；今年營業活動的現金流量總計 {{money:vars.ocf}}。現金流量比率是多少？算不出來時請按「N/A」。
prompt.en: Sea Breeze Guesthouse paid off all its short-term borrowings and trade payables at year end, so current liabilities on the balance sheet are {{money:vars.cl}}; net cash from operating activities this year is {{money:vars.ocf}}. What is the cash flow ratio? If it cannot be calculated, press ‘N/A’.

explanation.zh-TW: 分母{{term:tm_c2y9b5ex}}是零，除法沒有定義，所以{{term:tm_555a7d2s}}不存在，顯示 N/A。這不是零，也不是無限大，只是「目前沒有流動負債可以拿來比」。
explanation.en: The denominator, {{term:tm_c2y9b5ex}}, is zero, so the division is undefined: the {{term:tm_555a7d2s}} does not exist and shows N/A. That is not zero and not infinity; there are simply no current liabilities to compare against.
